review: 120.4a-2: forge_notes claimed the deathtouch clause of 120.4a could not be illustrated; added 120.4a-3 (Ram Through from Argothian Swine equipped with Gorgon's Head into Hill Giant, with an unattached-equipment variant) and updated the note.

scenarios.title: Damage dealt to a noncreature permanent has no result
decisions: A casts Pyroclasm, tapping both Mountains.
B passes priority; Pyroclasm resolves.

variants.label: not_animated
variants.expected: Pyroclasm deals 2 damage to each creature. Hill Giant has 2 damage marked and stays on the battlefield. Mutavault is a land and not a creature, so it is dealt no damage: it has no damage marked and stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: animated
variants.delta: In response to Pyroclasm, B activates Mutavault's {1} ability, tapping Forest, and Mutavault becomes a 2/2 creature until end of turn.
variants.expected: Mutavault is a creature when Pyroclasm resolves and is dealt 2 damage, which is lethal. Mutavault moves to B's graveyard in the state-based check. Hill Giant has 2 damage marked and stays.

scenarios.title: Each attacking and blocking creature deals combat damage equal to its power

setup.notes: All creatures have been under their controllers' control since the start of the turn.

decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears as an attacker, attacking B.
B declares Hill Giant as a blocker of Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass priority through the declare blockers step into the combat damage step.

variants.label: both_deal
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears deals 2 combat damage to Hill Giant and Hill Giant deals 3 combat damage to Grizzly Bears, simultaneously. Hill Giant has 2 damage marked and survives. Grizzly Bears has 3 damage marked and moves to A's graveyard. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: pumped
variants.delta: After blockers are declared, A casts Giant Growth on Grizzly Bears, tapping Forest, and it resolves.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is 5/5 and deals 5 combat damage to Hill Giant; Hill Giant deals 3 to Grizzly Bears. Hill Giant moves to B's graveyard. Grizzly Bears has 3 damage marked and survives.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.delta: B declares no blockers.
variants.expected: Hill Giant is not blocking and deals no combat damage. Grizzly Bears deals 2 combat damage to B, whose life is 18. No creature has damage marked.

scenarios.title: A spell that names a creature as the source makes that creature the damage source

setup.notes: All creatures have been under their controllers' control since the start of the turn.

decisions: A casts Rabid Bite, tapping both Forests, with Grizzly Bears as the creature that deals damage and Black Knight as the target creature B controls.
B passes priority; Rabid Bite resolves.

variants.label: green_source
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears (green) is the source and deals 2 damage to Black Knight. Black Knight has 2 damage marked and moves to B's graveyard in the state-based check.

variants.label: white_source
variants.delta: The creature A chooses to deal the damage is Savannah Lions (white, 2 power) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Savannah Lions is the source of the 2 damage. Black Knight has protection from white, so the damage is prevented. Black Knight has no damage marked and stays on the battlefield. Rabid Bite is green and could target it.

scenarios.forge_notes: Rabid Bite is implemented with DamageSource$ ParentTarget, so the creature is the damage source.

scenarios.title: Damage from a source without infect makes a player lose life

setup.notes: All creatures have been under their controllers' control since the start of the turn.

decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears as an attacker, attacking B.
B declares no blockers.
Both players pass priority into the combat damage step.

variants.label: no_infect
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears deals 2 combat damage to B. B loses 2 life and is at 18. B has no poison counters.

variants.label: infect
variants.delta: A attacks with Glistener Elf (1/1 infect) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Glistener Elf deals 1 damage to B in the form of a poison counter. B's life stays 20 and B has 1 poison counter.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B declares Hill Giant as a blocker of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: No combat damage is dealt to B. B's life stays 20. Hill Giant has 2 damage marked and Grizzly Bears moves to A's graveyard.

scenarios.title: Damage from an infect source gives a player poison counters

setup.notes: All creatures have been under their controllers' control since the start of the turn.

decisions: A declares Glistener Elf as an attacker, attacking B.
B declares no blockers.
Both players pass priority into the combat damage step.

variants.label: infect
variants.expected: Glistener Elf deals 1 damage to B in the form of 1 poison counter. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: no_infect
variants.delta: A attacks with Grizzly Bears (no infect) instead of Glistener Elf.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to B, who loses 2 life and is at 18. B has no poison counters.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B declares Hill Giant as a blocker of Glistener Elf.
variants.expected: B receives no poison counters and keeps 20 life. Glistener Elf deals its damage to Hill Giant as one -1/-1 counter, and Glistener Elf is dealt 3 damage and dies.

scenarios.title: Damage dealt to a planeswalker removes loyalty counters
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Jace Beleren, tapping Mountain.
B passes priority; Shock resolves.

variants.label: shock
variants.expected: Shock deals 2 damage to Jace Beleren. Two loyalty counters are removed and Jace Beleren has 1 loyalty. It stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: prevented
variants.delta: In response, B casts Mending Hands targeting Jace Beleren, tapping Plains.
variants.expected: Mending Hands prevents the next 4 damage to Jace Beleren, so Shock's 2 damage is prevented. No loyalty counters are removed and Jace Beleren has 3 loyalty.

scenarios.title: Damage from a wither or infect source to a creature puts -1/-1 counters on it

setup.notes: All creatures have been under their controllers' control since the start of the turn.

decisions: A declares Sickle Ripper as an attacker, attacking B.
B declares Hill Giant as a blocker of Sickle Ripper.
Both players pass priority into the combat damage step.

variants.label: wither
variants.expected: Sickle Ripper (2/1 wither) deals 2 damage to Hill Giant as two -1/-1 counters. Hill Giant is a 1/1 with two -1/-1 counters and no damage marked. Hill Giant deals 3 damage to Sickle Ripper, which dies.

variants.label: no_wither
variants.delta: A attacks with Savannah Lions (2/1, no wither) instead of Sickle Ripper.
variants.expected: Savannah Lions deals 2 damage to Hill Giant, marked as damage. Hill Giant is still a 3/3 with no counters and 2 damage marked. Savannah Lions dies.

variants.label: infect
variants.delta: A attacks with Glistener Elf (1/1 infect) instead of Sickle Ripper.
variants.expected: Glistener Elf deals 1 damage to Hill Giant as one -1/-1 counter. Hill Giant is a 2/2 with no damage marked. Glistener Elf dies.

scenarios.title: Damage from a source with neither wither nor infect is marked on a creature

setup.notes: All creatures have been under their controllers' control since the start of the turn.

decisions: A declares Savannah Lions as an attacker, attacking B.
B declares Hill Giant as a blocker of Savannah Lions.
Both players pass priority into the combat damage step.

variants.label: plain
variants.expected: Savannah Lions deals 2 damage to Hill Giant. Hill Giant has 2 damage marked and no counters, and stays a 3/3 on the battlefield. Savannah Lions dies.

variants.label: wither
variants.delta: A attacks with Sickle Ripper (2/1 wither) instead of Savannah Lions.
variants.expected: Sickle Ripper deals its damage as two -1/-1 counters. Hill Giant has no damage marked and is a 1/1. Sickle Ripper dies.

scenarios.title: Damage dealt by a lifelink source makes its controller gain that much life

setup.notes: All creatures have been under their controllers' control since the start of the turn.

decisions: A declares Child of Night as an attacker, attacking B.
B declares no blockers.
Both players pass priority into the combat damage step.

variants.label: unblocked_lifelink
variants.expected: Child of Night deals 2 damage to B. B loses 2 life (18) and A gains 2 life (22).

variants.label: blocked_lifelink
variants.delta: B declares Hill Giant as a blocker of Child of Night.
variants.expected: Child of Night deals 2 damage to Hill Giant and A gains 2 life (22). B's life stays 20. Child of Night dies.

variants.label: no_lifelink
variants.delta: A attacks with Savannah Lions (no lifelink) instead of Child of Night.
variants.expected: Savannah Lions deals 2 damage to B (18). A's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: Combat damage to a player from a toxic creature also gives poison counters

setup.notes: All creatures have been under their controllers' control since the start of the turn.

decisions: A declares Branchblight Stalker (3/1, toxic 2) as an attacker, attacking B.
B declares no blockers.
Both players pass priority into the combat damage step.

variants.label: toxic_unblocked
variants.expected: Branchblight Stalker deals 3 combat damage to B. B loses 3 life (17) and gets 2 poison counters.

variants.label: toxic_blocked
variants.delta: B declares Grizzly Bears as a blocker of Branchblight Stalker.
variants.expected: The damage goes to Grizzly Bears, not to a player. B's life stays 20 and B gets no poison counters. Both creatures die.

variants.label: not_toxic
variants.delta: A attacks with Savannah Lions (no toxic) instead of Branchblight Stalker.
variants.expected: Savannah Lions deals 2 damage to B (18). B gets no poison counters.

scenarios.title: Damage dealt to a battle removes defense counters

setup.notes: A controls the Siege and B is the opponent chosen to protect it.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting Invasion of Dominaria, tapping Mountain.
B passes priority; Shock resolves.

variants.label: shock
variants.expected: Shock deals 2 damage to Invasion of Dominaria. Two defense counters are removed and it has 3 defense counters. It stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: prevented
variants.delta: In response, B casts Mending Hands targeting Invasion of Dominaria, tapping Plains.
variants.expected: Shock's 2 damage is prevented by Mending Hands. No defense counters are removed and Invasion of Dominaria has 5 defense counters.

scenarios.forge_notes: Requires Forge's Any target filter to include battles and the battle to be placed with B as protector.

scenarios.title: Damage is modified by prevention, processed into results, modified again, and then occurs

setup.notes: All creatures have been under their controllers' control since the start of the turn.

decisions: A declares Child of Night (2/1 lifelink) as an attacker, attacking B.
B declares no blockers.
In the declare blockers step, B activates Samite Healer, tapping it, targeting B (prevent the next 1 damage to B this turn); it resolves.
Both players pass priority into the combat damage step.

variants.label: prevent_and_double
variants.expected: The damage event starts as 2 damage to B. Samite Healer's prevention makes it 1 damage. It is processed into B losing 1 life and A gaining 1 life; Boon Reflection doubles the gain to 2. B is at 19 and A is at 22.

variants.label: no_prevention
variants.delta: B does not activate Samite Healer.
variants.expected: The 2 damage is dealt. B loses 2 life (18). A gains 2 life from lifelink, doubled by Boon Reflection to 4 (24).

variants.label: no_boon
variants.delta: A does not control Boon Reflection (the card is not on the battlefield).
variants.expected: The prevention makes the damage 1. B loses 1 life (19) and A gains 1 life (21), with no doubling.

scenarios.forge_notes: Samite Healer's prevention shield on a player must apply to combat damage before lifelink computes the life gain.

scenarios.title: Excess damage is redirected to the creature's controller
decisions: A casts Flame Spill targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping the three Mountains.
B passes priority; Flame Spill resolves.

variants.label: excess_2
variants.expected: Lethal damage for Grizzly Bears is 2 of the 4. Grizzly Bears is dealt 2 damage and B is dealt the 2 excess damage (18). Grizzly Bears dies in the state-based check.

variants.label: exactly_lethal
variants.delta: Flame Spill targets Craw Wurm (6/4) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: All 4 damage is lethal damage, so there is no excess. B stays at 20 and Craw Wurm dies.

variants.label: already_damaged
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears has 1 damage marked before Flame Spill resolves.
variants.expected: Lethal damage is only 1 more. Grizzly Bears is dealt 1 damage and B is dealt 3 excess damage (17).

scenarios.title: Excess damage from a trampling source is redirected only when the effect says so

setup.notes: All creatures have been under their controllers' control since the start of the turn.

decisions: A casts Ram Through, tapping both Forests, with Argothian Swine as the creature that deals damage and Grizzly Bears as the target.
B passes priority; Ram Through resolves.

variants.label: trample
variants.expected: Argothian Swine (3/3 trample) deals 3 damage: 2 to Grizzly Bears, which dies, and the 1 excess damage to B (19).

variants.label: no_trample
variants.delta: The creature that deals damage is Hill Giant (3/3, no trample) instead of Argothian Swine.
variants.expected: Hill Giant deals all 3 damage to Grizzly Bears, which dies. There is no redirection and B stays at 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: The deathtouch clause of 120.4a is illustrated separately by 120.4a-3.

scenarios.title: Any damage beyond 1 from a deathtouch source is excess damage

setup.notes: Gorgon's Head is attached to Argothian Swine, which therefore has deathtouch and trample.

decisions: A casts Ram Through, tapping both Forests, with Argothian Swine as the creature that deals damage and Hill Giant as the target.
B passes priority; Ram Through resolves.

variants.label: deathtouch
variants.expected: Argothian Swine deals 1 damage to Hill Giant and the 2 excess damage to B (18). Hill Giant moves to B's graveyard in the state-based check.

variants.label: no_deathtouch
variants.delta: Gorgon's Head is on A's battlefield unattached, so Argothian Swine does not have deathtouch.
variants.expected: Argothian Swine deals all 3 damage to Hill Giant, which is exactly lethal, so there is no excess. B stays at 20 and Hill Giant moves to B's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: Requires Forge's ExcessDamage computation to treat 1 damage as lethal from a deathtouch source.

scenarios.title: Prevention changes the damage amount and damage-dealt triggers fire only on damage that is dealt

setup.notes: Samite Healer has been under B's control since the start of the turn.

decisions: A casts Lightning Bolt targeting Jackal Pup, tapping Mountain.
B passes priority; Lightning Bolt resolves.

variants.label: no_prevention
variants.expected: Jackal Pup is dealt 3 damage, its trigger fires and deals 3 damage to B (17). Jackal Pup dies.

variants.label: prevent_1
variants.delta: In response, B activates Samite Healer, tapping it, targeting Jackal Pup (prevent the next 1 damage).
variants.expected: The damage is reduced from 3 to 2. Jackal Pup is dealt 2 damage, its trigger fires and deals 2 damage to B (18). Jackal Pup dies.

variants.label: prevent_all
variants.delta: In response, B casts Mending Hands targeting Jackal Pup, tapping Plains.
variants.expected: All 3 damage is prevented. No damage is dealt, Jackal Pup's trigger does not fire, B stays at 20 and Jackal Pup stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: A replacement effect on a damage result applies to the processed result

setup.notes: All creatures have been under their controllers' control since the start of the turn.

decisions: A declares Child of Night (2/1 lifelink) as an attacker, attacking B.
B declares no blockers.
Both players pass priority into the combat damage step.

variants.label: boon_mine
variants.expected: B loses 2 life (18). The lifelink gain of 2 is doubled by Boon Reflection and A gains 4 life (24).

variants.label: boon_theirs
variants.delta: B controls Boon Reflection instead of A.
variants.expected: Boon Reflection only affects its controller's life gain. B loses 2 life (18) and A gains 2 life (22).

variants.label: no_lifelink
variants.delta: A attacks with Savannah Lions (no lifelink) instead of Child of Night.
variants.expected: There is no life gain to replace. B loses 2 life (18) and A stays at 20.

scenarios.title: Damage does not destroy a creature, state-based actions do
decisions: A casts Lightning Bolt targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain.
B passes priority; Lightning Bolt resolves.

variants.label: not_indestructible
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage, which is marked on Grizzly Bears. Grizzly Bears moves to B's graveyard only in the state-based check after Lightning Bolt has finished resolving.

variants.label: indestructible
variants.delta: Lightning Bolt targets Darksteel Myr (0/1 indestructible) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Darksteel Myr is dealt 3 damage and has 3 damage marked. The state-based check does not destroy it, so it stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: Damage marked on a creature accumulates through the turn and is lethal at toughness
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Hill Giant, tapping a Mountain; it resolves.
A casts a second Shock targeting Hill Giant, tapping the other Mountain; it resolves.

variants.label: two_shocks
variants.expected: After the first Shock Hill Giant has 2 damage marked and stays on the battlefield. After the second the total marked damage is 4, at least its toughness of 3, and Hill Giant moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: one_shock
variants.delta: A casts only the first Shock.
variants.expected: Hill Giant has 2 damage marked, less than its toughness of 3, and stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: Marked damage is removed in the cleanup step
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Hill Giant during the end step, tapping Mountain; it resolves.

variants.label: same_turn
variants.expected: Hill Giant still has its 2 damage marked, so Shock brings the total to 4, at least its toughness of 3, and Hill Giant moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: next_turn
variants.delta: A passes priority in the end step and casts Shock during B's following upkeep instead, after the cleanup step.
variants.expected: The 2 damage was removed in the cleanup step. Shock deals 2 damage to a Hill Giant with no damage marked. It has 2 damage marked, less than its toughness of 3, and stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: Regenerating removes all damage marked on a permanent
decisions: A casts Lightning Bolt targeting Drudge Skeletons, tapping Mountain.
B passes priority; Lightning Bolt resolves.

variants.label: no_shield
variants.expected: Drudge Skeletons has 3 damage marked, at least its toughness of 1, and moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: regenerated
variants.delta: In response, B activates Drudge Skeletons' regeneration ability, tapping Swamp.
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage. The state-based destruction is replaced by the regeneration shield: Drudge Skeletons becomes tapped, all damage is removed (0 marked), and it stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: A source that would deal 0 damage deals no damage, so damage triggers do not fire

setup.notes: All creatures have been under their controllers' control since the start of the turn.

decisions: A declares Darksteel Myr (0/1) as an attacker, attacking B.
B declares Jackal Pup as a blocker of Darksteel Myr.
Both players pass priority into the combat damage step.

variants.label: zero_power
variants.expected: Darksteel Myr deals no damage. Jackal Pup is not dealt damage, so its trigger does not fire and B stays at 20. Jackal Pup deals 2 damage to Darksteel Myr, which is indestructible and stays.

variants.label: two_power
variants.delta: A attacks with Grizzly Bears (2/2) instead of Darksteel Myr.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Jackal Pup and its trigger fires, dealing 2 damage to B (18). Jackal Pup and Grizzly Bears both die.

scenarios.title: A trigger on damage by a specific source refers only to that source's damage

setup.notes: All creatures have been under their controllers' control since the start of the turn.

decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears as an attacker, attacking B.
B declares Hill Giant as a blocker of Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass priority into the combat damage step.

variants.label: linked_attacker
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage and Hill Giant deals 3 damage at the same time. Spirit Link triggers on Grizzly Bears' damage only: A gains 2 life (22), not 5.

variants.label: linked_bystander
variants.delta: Spirit Link is attached to Savannah Lions, which is not in combat, instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The same combat damage is dealt, but the enchanted creature deals no damage. Spirit Link does not trigger and A stays at 20.

variants.label: linked_blocker
variants.delta: Spirit Link is attached to Hill Giant instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Spirit Link triggers on Hill Giant's 3 damage only. A, who controls Spirit Link, gains 3 life (23).

scenarios.forge_notes: Spirit Link attached to an opponent's creature is only reached by setting up the state directly.

scenarios.title: An excess-damage trigger fires when the damage exceeds lethal damage
decisions: A casts Lightning Bolt targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain.
B passes priority; Lightning Bolt resolves.

variants.label: excess
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is dealt 3 damage, 1 more than lethal. Magmatic Galleon's trigger fires and A creates a Treasure token. Grizzly Bears dies.

variants.label: exactly_lethal
variants.delta: Lightning Bolt targets Hill Giant (3/3) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Hill Giant is dealt exactly lethal damage, so there is no excess. Magmatic Galleon does not trigger and A creates no Treasure. Hill Giant dies.

scenarios.title: Excess damage counts damage already marked on the creature
decisions: A casts Lightning Bolt targeting Hill Giant, tapping Mountain.
B passes priority; Lightning Bolt resolves.

variants.label: pre_damaged
variants.expected: Hill Giant needs only 2 more damage to be lethal and is dealt 3, so 1 damage is excess. Magmatic Galleon's trigger fires and A creates a Treasure token.

variants.label: undamaged
variants.delta: Hill Giant has no damage marked.
variants.expected: Hill Giant is dealt exactly lethal damage with no excess. Magmatic Galleon does not trigger and A creates no Treasure.
